remarks: Excellent downtown location - close to everything! Bright and sunny newly renovated unit, 980 sf 2 Bedroom 1 Bath unit on the 4th floor with an expansive view of Stamford. The spacious Living Room has room for a Dining Area or an Office and access to your own private Terrace perfect for dining, entertaining or relaxing. The Primary Bedroom is a generous size with a large double closet. Nice size Kitchen with dishwasher, gas range, new microwave, and refrigerator. Laundry on first floor of complex. Rent includes Heat, Hot Water and Gas. Garage parking available 1/2 a block away at the Bedford Street garage for extra charge. Vibrant downtown Stamford is just steps away including restaurants, theaters, library and a short walk to the train.
